name: The Nguyen Family
headline: Sold $52,000 over asking in 4 days
quote: We interviewed three teams. The other two talked about the market — Elena and Devon walked us through a room-by-room prep list, brought in their stager and photographer, and had a launch date on the calendar before they left. Four days later we had three offers.

name: Priya & Marcus
headline: Relocated from Toronto without losing a commute day
quote: I still go into the Toronto office twice a week. Devon mapped every listing against the GO schedule and told us honestly which ones would make the 6:52. We bought four blocks from the station and my commute got shorter than it was in Etobicoke.
result: Purchased at $562,000 · 96 min door-to-door to Union

name: David Okonkwo
headline: Four offers on an estate lot in a slow month
quote: They told me to wait three weeks and spend $8,000 on staging and photography in a market everyone said was dead. I pushed back. They were right — four offers, $67,000 over, and the buyer told me later the drone video is what got them in the door.

name: Sam & Jordan Reilly
headline: First home, and nobody made us feel small for asking
quote: We had a lot of questions and a modest budget. They answered every one of them and never once pushed us above what we said we were comfortable with. The land transfer tax rebate alone paid for our appliances.

name: Dr. Anita Shah
headline: Sold and bought in the same week without a bridge loan
quote: Coordinating a sale and a purchase with two kids and a hospital schedule sounded impossible. They ran both timelines on one calendar, negotiated matching closing dates, and I never had to think about it.
result: Sold $1,118,000 · Purchased same week · Matched closings

name: The Bergerons
headline: Talked us out of the wrong house twice
quote: Twice they told us to walk away from houses we loved — once for a foundation issue, once because the price didn't hold up against the comps. That's the part you don't get from an app.
